title: SQL
description: SQL queries: SELECT, filtering, sorting, joins, grouping, inserts, updates, schema changes and transactions.

sections.title: Querying
rows: SELECT name AS full_name FROM users;
SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY created_at DESC;

sections.title: Filtering
rows: WHERE id IN (SELECT user_id FROM orders)
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = users.id)

sections.title: Joins
rows:
SELECT u.*
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id
WHERE o.id IS NULL;
SELECT * FROM a FULL OUTER JOIN b ON a.id = b.id;
SELECT email FROM users UNION SELECT email FROM leads;

sections.title: Grouping & aggregates
rows:
SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(total), AVG(total), MIN(total), MAX(total)
FROM orders;

SELECT country, COUNT(*)
FROM users
GROUP BY country
HAVING COUNT(*) > 100;

sections.title: Changing data
rows: INSERT INTO archive SELECT * FROM orders WHERE created_at < '2024-01-01';
UPDATE users SET status = 'active' WHERE id = 7;
DELETE FROM sessions WHERE expires_at < NOW();

INSERT INTO users (email, name) VALUES ('a@x.com', 'Ada')
ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name;
UPDATE users SET name = 'Ada' WHERE id = 1 RETURNING *;

sections.title: Schema
rows: user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN phone TEXT;
ALTER TABLE users RENAME COLUMN phone TO mobile;
ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN mobile;

CREATE VIEW active_users AS
SELECT * FROM users WHERE status = 'active';

sections.title: Transactions & admin
rows: EXPLAIN SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = 'a@x.com';
GRANT SELECT, INSERT ON users TO app;
